name: Run Estate Notice Fetcher
script:
if doc.status == "Pending" and not doc.job_log:
    doc.status = "Running"
    doc.job_log = "Job queued..."
    
    # We enqueue a background job to run the scripts
    frappe.enqueue(
        "estate_notice.setup_frontend.run_fetcher_job",
        queue="long",
        timeout=3600,
        job_name=doc.name,
        doc_name=doc.name
    )
